# workflows

ci.yml checks unique src/provenance, lint, static tests and MCP compatibility with
Node 24.13.0/Bun 1.4.0. It does not claim recovered-source compilation.

qualify-npm-runtime.yml runs on main push or manual dispatch, builds on four native
hosts, delegates protocol/auth state to real official fixtures, exercises Dream's pinned
production MCP driver, packages/stages/smokes platform bytes and aggregates the package-root
selector only after all hosts pass. Diagnostic uploads include bounded receipts only.

publish-npm.yml automatically follows successful qualification, or accepts its run ID
for immutable retry. It validates current main/source SHA and repository/workflow identity,
downloads the exact qualified five-package set, verifies it and publishes platforms before
selector using the existing npm environment token or OIDC. Registry sha512 must match.
The private repository root is never published. Missing package capabilities remain a
real failure, not a disabled placeholder or a claim of successful deployment.
